title: Tumor-infiltrating B cells evolve towards interferon-rich trajectories aligned with immunotherapy in melanoma.
publicationName: Journal of experimental & clinical cancer research : CR

snippet: B cells are increasingly recognized regulators of antitumor immunity in melanoma, yet their differentiation states, lineage dynamics, spatial organization and integration within the immune microenvironment, and how these are influenced with immunotherapy remain incompletely defined.
